integrity: The curve-specific premises are taken from inspected primary text. The finite incidence and automorphism assertions are independently reconstructed and exhaustively checked by the embedded exact program. The abstract arrangement-graph automorphism result is not claimed as new.
scientific_limitations: The result concerns only the sixty class-(i) tritangents with three Weierstrass contacts.
Only type-preserving incidence automorphisms are classified; point-block dualities of the Levi graph are outside the claim.
The extra S3 is an incidence/Galois symmetry and is not asserted to consist of holomorphic automorphisms of Bring's curve.
The full text of Edge's 1981 tritangent paper was not available for comparison, leaving a classical-terminology originality risk.
title: The Weierstrass tritangent configuration of Bring's curve is the clique geometry of \(A_{5,3}\)
